world?|[[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]|}} The '''Duel on Byss''' was a [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|lightsaber duel]] between [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] in the latter's [[Clone Labs]] on [[Byss/Legends|Byss]]. ==History== ===Background=== [[File:Leia_and_Sidious.jpg|thumb|left|Palpatine attempts to turn Organa Solo to the dark side of the Force.]] After [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] made a partial turn to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] and became an [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] to [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], his sister, [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]], traveled to Byss in an attempt to rescue him. Unfortunately, she only succeeded in getting herself, [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] and [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] captured. Palpatine was quick to take advantage of this and attempted to turn Leia to the dark side as well. Tempting her with the [[Tedryn Holocron]], which he had in his possession, and stirring her anger by revealing his twisted intentions for her unborn child, his attempt backfired and she fled in anger. Aided by Luke, who had been secretly sabotaging the Emperor's schemes, she fled along with Han, Chewbacca, C-3PO and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]]. Furnished with the master control codes for the [[World Devastator]]s attacking [[Dac/Legends|Mon Calamari]], she allowed the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] forces to win the battle. Meanwhile, Luke finally engaged in open rebellion against Palpatine. ===The Duel=== ====Palpatine's Clones==== {{Quote|Skywalker… I sense your presence… how did you get in here? The clone lab is sealed… my moment of transference is close… no one is allowed in here now.''"
"''I have come to prevent the transition.|Palpatine and Luke Skywalker|}} [[File:Palpatine_rises.jpg|thumb|Palpatine rises in his new body.]] As the Emperor's current clone body lay dying in the lab, Luke Skywalker stormed in and confronted Palpatine, lightsaber drawn. When Palpatine threatened to [[Essence transfer|transfer his consciousness]] into Skywalker himself, Luke called his bluff. Sitting back, Palpatine allowed his current body to die in a flash of Force energy. Realizing that Palpatine could only enter a living body, Luke went on a destructive spree through the clone lab, shattering one tank after another, sending the Sith Lord's genetic offspring to mindless, babbling deaths. Unfortunately for Luke, one of the bodies was not quite dead. Rising to his feet in his new body, the Dark Lord of the Sith faced the Jedi Master. Stating his belief in Luke's inferiority, Palpatine was then smashed against one of the walls of the lab by a [[Telekinesis/Legends|Force Push]]. ====Turning the Tables==== {{Quote|You forget, I am a Jedi Master now… and I know something about the dark side.''"
"''Does your dark side knowledge tell you how many other so-called "Jedi Masters" failed to vanquish me? Does your knowledge tell you that I have already beaten you?|Luke Skywalker and Palpatine|}} [[File:L_defeated_by_P.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Skywalker is defeated by Palpatine.]] Seizing one of the lightsabers mounted on the wall next to him, a relic of the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Jedi Purge]], Palpatine ignited it and charged Luke. Gathering strength moment by moment, the young Emperor lashed out with the Jedi weapon, pushing Skywalker to his limits. Despite his mastery of [[Form V/Legends|Form V]] [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]],{{InsiderCite|62|Fightsaber: Jedi Lightsaber Combat}} Luke was forced to draw on all his resources simply to parry the Emperor's blows. Locking blades, they had a brief exchange, Luke stating his belief in the dark side's ultimate failure, Palpatine reaffirming his belief in the dark side, and thusly his own, superior strength. In a sudden display of incredible strength, Palpatine pushed forward, breaking the blade-lock and swung his saber downwards, pivoting to the side as he did so. His sudden move flicked Luke's lightsaber aside and caused the Jedi to lose balance. As Luke fell, Palpatine advanced, his saber at Luke's throat. Holding the Jedi at bladepoint, Palpatine completed Luke's turn to the dark side, reducing him to a subservient watchdog. {{Quote|You. Are. Nothing.''"
"''Where am I?''"
"''Alone.''"
"''No - Help me-''"
"''There is no one. There is only the Dark Side.''"
"''I... am... a Jedi. Aaaaah!''"
"''You are not Jedi. You are nothing. You have no name.''"
"''My name - is - Skywalker! AAAAAAH!''"
"''YOU. HAVE. NO. NAME!''"
"''I-''"
"''Listen to the Dark Side. You have no name.''"
"''I have... *dully*no name.''"
"''You serve the Dark Side.''"
"''I... s-serve...|Palpatine breaking Luke's spirit after the duel|[[Dark Empire (audio drama)|''Dark Empire'' audio drama]]}} In addition, to further ensure that Luke had turned to the Dark Side, he also inserted himself into Luke's mind and proceeded to break Luke's spirit until Luke was left significantly broken to the extent that he even disavowed his own name. ===Aftermath=== {{Quote|We are going to find your sister! I want my holocron… and I want your sister's child. I am going to crush this rebellion once and for all!|Palpatine, to Skywalker|}} [[File:Palpatines_demands.jpg|thumb|100px|Palpatine making his demands to the New Republic via hologram while a subservient Skywalker observes.]] Palpatine immediately afterwards journeyed to the Pinnacle moon in his flagship; ''Eclipse''; with a subservient Luke Skywalker in tow. Contacting the New Republic leaders, he demanded the presence of Leia and the return of his Jedi holocron, and promised to discuss a truce with the Republic. Leia complied to the Emperor's demand for her presence, but left the holocron behind. Thanks to her, Luke managed to shake off the shroud of the dark side completely and turned on Palpatine. After a swift [[Battle of Pinnacle Base|rematch]], Luke won but Palpatine, in a display of defiance, summoned a [[Force storm (wormhole)|Force storm]] and began to destroy the Republic fleet. Luke and Leia banded together and temporarily [[Force harmony|cut off]] Palpatine's connection to the Force, and thusly control of the Force storm. While the wayward storm destroyed ''Eclipse'' and killed the Emperor, Luke and Leia fled, and Luke announced his plans to rebuild the Jedi Order. ==Behind the scenes== The Duel on Byss first appeared in the issue [[Dark Empire 5|''Dark Empire'' 5]] of the ''[[Star Wars: Dark Empire]]'' series of comics. The battle was conceived and written by authors [[Tom Veitch]], was drawn by artist [[Dave Dorman]] and colored by colorist [[Cam Kennedy]]. Veitch used this as one of the conflicts leading up to the final climax between Palpatine and the Skywalker twins during the [[Battle of Pinnacle Base]]. The Duel on Byss would eventually be featured in the [[Dark Empire (audio drama)|''Dark Empire'' audio drama]], in which [[John Cygan]] voiced Luke Skywalker and [[Nick Jameson]] voiced Palpatine. This duel is one of the shortest lightsaber duels illustrated in a comic, only taking up a total of three panels over the course of two pages. In real-world chronological order of publishing, this is the first lightsaber duel to feature both the Jedi and Sith Lord involved wielding blue lightsabers. This type of duel would reoccur in the [[2005]] [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']] [[Duel on Mustafar/Legends|between]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]].{{Film|III}} ==Appearances== *[[Dark Empire (audio drama)|''Dark Empire'' audio drama]] *[[Dark Empire 5|''Dark Empire'' 5]] {{1st}} ==Sources== *[[Dark Empire endnotes|''Dark Empire'' endnotes]] *''[[The Essential Guide to Characters]]'' *[[The Essential Chronology (real-world book)|''The Essential Chronology'']] *''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe, Third Edition, Revised and Expanded]]'' *''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' *{{InsiderCite|158|Of Light and Darkness: The Making of Dark Empire – Part II|Of Light and Darkness: The Making of ''Dark Empire'' – Part II|reprint=1}} ===Non-canon sources=== *{{InQuestCite|50|Star Wars Episode VII: Rise of the New Republic}} {{C|Non-[[canon]]ical source}} {{Un}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{GCW Shadow Hand}} {{Interlang |es=Duelo en Byss }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Byss, Duel on}} [[Category:Battles of Byss]] [[Category:Battles of Operation Shadow Hand]] [[Category:Lightsaber duels]]
